import re

with open('/tmp/parse_new.py', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Find the alignment handling section and modify it for < and ^ alignments
old_align_handling = '''        # align "=" has been handled
        if align == '<':
            s = '%s%s*' % (s, fill)
        elif align == '>':
            s = '%s*%s' % (fill, s)
        elif align == '^':
            s = '%s*%s%s*' % (fill, s, fill)'''

new_align_handling = '''        # align "=" has been handled
        if align == '<':
            # For left-aligned search, consume up to next space
            s = '([^ ]+) %s*' % fill
        elif align == '>':
            s = '%s*%s' % (fill, s)
        elif align == '^':
            # For center-aligned search, consume up to next space
            s = '%s*([^ ]+)(?: %s*)?' % (fill, fill)'''

if old_align_handling in content:
    content = content.replace(old_align_handling, new_align_handling)
    with open('/tmp/parse_new2.py', 'w') as f:
        f.write(content)
    print("Replacement successful")
else:
    print("Pattern not found!")
    # Debug
    idx = content.find('align "=" has been handled')
    if idx >= 0:
        print("Found marker at", idx)
        print(content[idx:idx+300])
    else:
        print("Marker not found either")
PYEOF
